name: Lena
source: Lena is Harth's long-time friend and next door neighbor. She comes from an influential and somewhat wealthy family that grew a modest fortune by trading precious metals and finely crafted jewelry. While Lena much prefers escaping into literature over the clamor of the family business, she still dutifully helps with book keeping and tends to errands in town when the rest of her family is traveling for work.  Distinctively quiet, reserved, and unimposing, Lena often has difficulty asserting herself and voicing her desires.  Her deferential and accommodating personality stands in stark contrast to her best friend Raisa.  Will Lena step up to discover and claim what her heart truly desires?
